base.authority: Human-named Production application baseline; no live Production identity or services accessed

implementation.result_source: Authoritative generations array (including empty) takes precedence; absent array falls back to legacy generation. Never extract artifacts or counts from reply URLs.
implementation.ordering: Backend array order, no client sort. Live task artifacts require exact artifact.task_id match.
implementation.layout: Desktop two columns, mobile <=860px one column; single card max360px. Preview height280px, object-fit:contain. Separate view/download controls; error retry is per image.
implementation.history: Use assistant message generations arrays; legacy scalar retained. Additional scoped conversation.generations get the same cards. Deduplicate by artifact ID; URL fallback only for ID-less old records. Distinct IDs sharing one URL are preserved.
implementation.path_redaction: Shared assistant display and copy policy for known generated storage/server/workspace/Windows/file paths, including Markdown link destinations/code blocks. Preserve business labels and ordinary external links. Streaming holds unfinished possible address tokens, reclassifies from whole displayed raw prefix. Raw SSE/task text and visual queue are not modified.
implementation.security_limit: Display redaction is not access control; backend-authorized resource/download URLs remain in src/href and network requests. User prompts are not rewritten.
implementation.cache: index.html and release toolchain unchanged; existing __JS_SHA256_V1__/__CSS_SHA256_V1_ mechanism retained
implementation.asset_hash_scope: assets_sha256 describes tested Windows working-copy bytes; git_object_assets_sha256 describes normalized Source object bytes. Approved release tooling must generate its cache keys from the exact deployed Source, not copy the working-copy hashes.

checks: actual fixture SSE split-delta DOM mutation monitoring
every artifact viewer and nonempty fixture GET download
fresh page reload and visible history reopening; mobile uses existing history page
partial 404 load failure and independent retry
failed and cancelled no false success/cursor
legacy history remainder with distinct IDs on same resource

tests.static_compile: node --check: workbench.js and both new test scripts PASS
tests.full_pytest: NOT_RUN: not frontend scope / not authorized release validation

evidence.labeling: All screenshots, Task/Run IDs, API responses, generated SVGs and business content are marked Fixture. No real Provider output or customer data.

requested_contract: completed SSE event and GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}: ordered generations[], each artifact task_id equals current task
GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}: assistant messages carry their scoped ordered generations[]; stable id/task_id and authorized content_url or storage_key; conversation-level generations retained
Persist and authorize every generated artifact; frontend cannot restore unpersisted historical files or infer them from model text
backend_dependency.final_integration: NOT_VERIFIED. Once 01 delivers exact Source/Tree, review field shapes, integrate through approved source workflow, and retest current Task + SSE/poll + reload + every authorized image download. Do not silently infer artifacts or bypass authorization.

observations: Known internal artifact-path patterns are a presentation policy, not universal filesystem/security classification.
Legacy scalar data cannot prove multi-image persistence; real multi-image acceptance remains dependent on 01.
